div.div:
Multi-tenancy-spine (hard rule):
organization_id → organizations op ÉLKE product-tabel
(NOT NULL, ON DELETE CASCADE).
Uitzonderingen:
• users — root, geen org
• v0_thread_messages — erft tenancy via thread_id
• firecrawl_credit_log — org_id NULLABLE (account-breed)
NB: geen chatbots-tabel — botconfig leeft in code
(lib/v0/server/bots.ts), DB-side pas in V1.
